import sys, json, pathlib, time, traceback
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); root=pathlib.Path('/app/output')
seq=0
obs=r.get_obs(depth=True)
def save(res):
 global obs,seq
 obs=res; seq+=1; d=root/f'run{seq:03d}'; res.save(str(d))
 canvas=Image.new('RGB',(672,248))
 for i,(cam,img) in enumerate(res.last.items()):
  canvas.paste(Image.fromarray(img),(i*224,24)); ImageDraw.Draw(canvas).text((i*224,0),cam.split(':')[1],fill='white')
 canvas.save(root/'view.jpg')
 print('RUN',seq,'META',{k:v for k,v in res.meta.items() if k not in ['cameras','proprio']},flush=True)
 print('POSE',pr(),flush=True)
 return res
def pr():
 p=obs.meta['proprio']; return dict(zip(p['layout'],p['now']))
def observe(): return save(r.get_obs(depth=True))
def act(a,dt=.1): return save(r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=dt,depth=True))
def ee(a): return save(r.submit('ee_pose',a,depth=True))
def joints():
 p=pr(); return np.array([p[n] for n in spec['action_types']['joint_position']['layout']],dtype=float)
save(obs)
print('READY',flush=True)
while True:
 f=root/'command.py'
 if f.exists():
  code=f.read_text(); f.unlink()
  with (root/'gen.py').open('a') as out: out.write('\n# Recorded control command\n'+code+'\n')
  try: exec(compile(code,str(f),'exec'),globals())
  except Exception: traceback.print_exc()
  print('COMMAND_DONE',flush=True)
 time.sleep(.2)
PY
